page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at top, with page number at top right. Two small marks ("2.F.") above the first lines, one at left and one at right. Text runs in a single block below. Gathering mark at the foot.

p.i: Secundo futuro fiunt præcepta affir-matiua, precationes & hortationes.

main_text.p: פָּקוֹד pakód, visitare, cum quatuor con-sonis seruilibus, quæ in vocem בְּכְלָם bach-lam, collectæ sunt, sic:
בִּפְקוֹד כִּפְקוֹד לִפְקוֹד מִפְּקוֹד biphkód, cùm visitaret, vel visitauisset, kiphkód, liph-kód, ad visitandum, vel, vt visitem, mip-pekód, vt non visitem, vel, ne visitem.

p.i: Prima infiniti absoluti habet camez, sed cùm literis Bachlam illud in scheva mutat.

main_text.p: פָּקֵד pakkéd, cum literis Bachlam: בְּפָקֵד כְּפָקֵד לְהָקֵד מִפָּקֵד bephakkéd, ke-phakked, lephakkéd, mippakked.
הַפְקֵד haphkéd, cum literis Bachlam: בְּהַפְקִיד כְּהַפְקִיד לְהַפְקִיד מֵהַפְקִיד behaph-kid, kehaphkid, lehaphkid, mehaphkid.

page.notes: The two "2.F." marks at the top are small printed marks above the text, placed one at each side. The Hebrew words are copied from a small, faded scan; the vowel points in the Hebrew forms, especially the first word of the top line and the forms in the last lines, are read with some doubt and are not marked with [?]. The Latin "consonis" and "Bachlam" are printed with the long-s form and the line-end hyphens as shown.
